functionality.rationale: Offer, acceptance, chunk flow, integrity, acknowledgement, and commit form the first complete transfer path.

security.rationale: Only authenticated, explicitly accepted, bounded, integrity-verified bytes may reach storage.

performance.rationale: Chunk sizing, credit, queue depth, hashing, and I/O determine throughput and memory use.

compatibility.rationale: Sender and receiver must implement the accepted v1 transfer messages and failure scopes exactly.

concurrency.rationale: Network completion, file I/O, acknowledgements, rejection, failure, and shutdown cross asynchronous domains.

platform.rationale: The transfer engine must preserve behavior above platform-specific sockets and filesystems.

persistence.rationale: The receiver writes temporary data and commits a durable destination after integrity verification.

adr.rationale: The task implements accepted wire and security contracts without changing them.

architecture.rationale: The architecture already assigns transfer and integrity behavior to native core.

roadmap.rationale: The one-file item closes only after public adapters, Flutter, and E2E acceptance.
